lines.text: Many learners say: I make my homework every night.
Better: I do my homework every night.
Do! I do my homework after dinner.

data.wrong: I make my homework every night.
data.right: I do my homework every night.

native.tip: Kita sering bilang “membuat PR”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai do homework.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I make my homework every night.” 😅 Untuk PR, pakai do: “I do my homework every night.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “do”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I do my homework every night.” Lalu tambahkan jamnya. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We often say “membuat PR”, but English uses do homework.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I make my homework every night.” 😅 For homework, use do: “I do my homework every night.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
